description: Trooth is the trust network for the software economy. This connector lets anyone in a ChatGPT conversation look up a company's current, witnessed record on Trooth across nine categories, from identity and security to privacy, AI practices, and history, each with its source and the date it was last read. Read a company before you rely on it, compare two vendors on the same categories before you buy, take a live neutral read of a domain's public security surface, verify a signed Trust Ledger Token, or ask how Trooth works. A company can also look up its own record to see what buyers see. Every answer names its source and date, witnessed evidence is labeled apart from what a company declares, and anything not settled comes back marked unknown rather than guessed. It is read-only and returns only public data, with no account and no login.
